title: KY PSC Order — Case No. 2020-00154: ELECTRONIC MARTIN COUNTY WATER DISTRICT MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION MONITORING PURSUANT TO KRS 278.250
text:
COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
In the Matter of: 
ELECTRONIC MARTIN COUNTY WATER 
DISTRICT MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION 
MONITORING PURSUANT TO KRS 278.250 
) 
) 
) 
CASE NO. 
2020-00154 
COMMISSION STAFF’S NOTICE OF INFORMAL CONFERENCE 
Commission Staff hereby schedules an informal conference on June 18, 2026, 
from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time, to take place via video conference link, to 
discuss the following matters: 
-
Information contained in the monthly packet prepared for the May 2026 Martin
County Water District board meeting;
-
Update on status of funding through administrator, FAHE;
-
Overview on current capital projects and future planned capital projects;
-
Update on plan for the use of funding to pay Martin District’s debts, including
the arrearage to Alliance;
-
Overview of contract between Alliance and Martin District, including fees and
contractual management duties of Alliance; and
-
Customer Account information – Number of accounts closed in the last 12
months, number of accounts opened in the last 12 months, number of
delinquent accounts per month for the last 12 months.
Commission Staff will contact participants by electronic mail to provide details for 
joining the conference by video link.
